common.disclaimer: Tinnara is a self-observation diary, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice. Talk to your doctor about what you log.

loud.question: How loud is your tinnitus today?
loud.infoWhat: Rate how loud the tinnitus was for most of the day – not the worst moment (that is what Louder now is for). The number is yours: compare it with your own days, not with other people.
infoScale: 1–3 – there if you listen for it
4–6 – noticeable, but you can tune it out
9–10 – as loud as it ever gets
loud.infoTip: Check in at about the same time every day, for example in the evening. Bother is logged separately because how much it gets to you often changes more than the loudness itself.

steps.title: One number a day
steps.body: How loud was it today, 0–10? Five seconds in the evening. Over weeks, that number becomes a curve you can actually show someone.

steps.title: Louder now
steps.body: When it suddenly spikes, one tap logs it. How it sounds, what set it off and what helped can wait.

steps.title: Private by design
steps.body: No account, no cloud, no tracking. Your diary lives on this phone, and only you can export it.

redFlags.link: When should I see a doctor quickly?
redFlags.title: When to see a doctor quickly
redFlags.intro: Most tinnitus is harmless in itself. A few situations need a doctor fast:
redFlags.urgentTitle: Same day – or call emergency services
urgent: Your hearing suddenly drops in one ear (within hours or a few days). Sudden hearing loss is treated best within days.
Tinnitus comes with sudden severe dizziness, facial weakness, double vision or trouble speaking.
It started after a blow to the head.
soon: It is only in one ear and does not go away.
It pulses in time with your heartbeat.
It comes with ear pain, discharge or a blocked ear that does not clear.
It is new and has not been checked.
It is hurting your sleep, mood or work – help is available.
redFlags.routine: Long-standing tinnitus that has been checked is usually not dangerous. Sound therapy, hearing aids and CBT-based programmes are available through your doctor or an ENT specialist.
redFlags.disclaimer: General information, not a diagnosis. If in doubt, call your doctor.

widget.title: Louder now widget
widget.settingsHint: Log a spike from the Home Screen or Lock Screen
widget.intro: One tap on the widget logs a spike – no need to find the app first.
stepsIos: Touch and hold an empty spot on your Home Screen until the apps jiggle.
Tap + (top left) and search for Tinnara.
Choose the small or medium widget and tap Add Widget.
stepsAndroid: Touch and hold an empty spot on your home screen.
Drag the widget onto your home screen.
widget.lockscreen: Lock Screen: touch and hold the Lock Screen → Customize → tap the widget area → Tinnara.

weather.infoWhy: Some people with tinnitus – especially with Ménière's disease or ear-pressure problems – notice changes when the air pressure shifts. Evidence is limited and it differs from person to person; the change matters more than the absolute value.
weather.infoApp: Tinnara stores the daily mean for your place and compares the days your spikes started with all other days. The pattern card and the report show that comparison – nothing more.
